verdict.rationale: Milvus documents a public client API through the pymilvus `MilvusClient` SDK. It covers collection management, vector CRUD, search, filtering and hybrid search, and the same API works across the Lite, Standalone and Distributed deployments. The README shows programmatic search calls, and a community user reports it was quick to implement and worked as intended. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and no direct evidence of a full API reference or of non-Python/REST interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This installs `pymilvus`, the Python SDK for Milvus. Use `MilvusClient` to create a client

Milvus Lite shares the same API with Milvus Standalone and Distributed, and covers most of the features such as vector data persistence and management, vector CRUD operations, sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering, multi-vector and hybrid_search.
from pymilvus import MilvusClient client = MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")

With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster
